as_told.title: Laurance Rockefeller as patron of UFO research

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the wealthy Rockefeller family, and Laurance Rockefeller in particular, quietly paid for a lot of UFO research in the 1990s. According to Michels, the money went to Steven Greer, a disclosure campaigner, to John Mack, a Harvard psychiatrist who studied people reporting alien abductions, to the writer Whitley Strieber, and to a lab at Princeton University that studied whether the mind can affect matter. He tells it because it would mean one of America's richest families was backing the subject behind the scenes.
